title: Wardrobes either side of a chimney breast
intro: This is what a customer gets before anything is made: their design in 3D, on their phone. Drag to turn it round, use the buttons under it to open the doors or take it apart, and pinch to zoom.

options.name: Option A: two wardrobes
options.text: A wardrobe in each alcove with panelled doors: a rail and shelves on one side, narrow shelves and space for the boiler on the other.

poster.alt: 3D SketchUp model of the two panelled wardrobes either side of the chimney breast, one with a rail and shelves, one built around the boiler

options.name: Option B: with a bridge
options.text: The wardrobes joined by cupboards over the chimney breast, up to the ceiling, with flat doors and wooden knobs.

poster.alt: 3D SketchUp model of the wall of wardrobes either side of the chimney breast, joined by a bridge of cupboards over the fireplace

notes: This example is made from two finished jobs, so the two options are different rooms. A real design shows options for the same room, drawn to the sizes measured on the visit.
Colours on screen are a guide.
